# Configuration for Speechmatics TTS

To use this TTS service in bot.py, replace the TTS initialization with:

from pipecat.services.speechmatics.tts import SpeechmaticsTTSService

tts = SpeechmaticsTTSService(
    api_key=os.getenv("API_KEY"),  # Use appropriate env var
    **{}
)
